title: Ultra-Right Strategist (Bolsonaro, Milei, Paz) Arrested for Attack on Ex-Partner
author: SinEmbargo Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by the SinEmbargo editorial staff originally appeared in
the[August 18, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4856291/detienen-a-estratega-de-la-
ultraderecha-bolsonaro-milei-paz-por-ataque-a-expareja), an independent
Mexican digital news outlet._

**WARNING: GRAPHIC IMAGES**

**Mexico City, August 18 (SinEmbargo).—** Fernando Cerimedo, considered a key
consultant for the South American ultra-right, was arrested this Tuesday at
the Viru Viru airport, in Bolivia, as he was about to take a flight to Buenos
Aires, Argentina. Cerimedo, who has worked for Argentine President Javier
Milei; for Jair Bolsonaro, former president of Brazil; and with the current
government of Bolivia, headed by Rodrigo Paz; among others, is accused of
hiring two or three hitmen who shot his ex-partner, Nadia Beller.

![Fernando Cerimedo, ultra-right political
consultant](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/2026-08-18-ultraright-strategist-arrested-
large.jpg)The former political adviser was arrested at the Viru Viru airport
as he tried to travel to Buenos Aires. Photo: Instagram @cerimedofernando

Beller was shot three times on Monday night in a hotel in Santa Cruz de la
Sierra and, according to the police report, the individuals pretended to be
delivery motorcyclists. Cerimedo's ex-partner, who is also the founder of the
media outlet La Derecha Diario and CEO of Numen Publicidad, remains
hospitalized and her condition is guarded.

According to Bolivian media, cited by the newspaper Página 12, Cerimedo and
the lawyer Nadia Beller were a couple and there were scenes of violence in the
relationship. The consultant claimed in recent days that this version is false
and came out to denounce a campaign against him.

![](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/1000003126.jpg)Cerimedo is now under investigation in
Bolivia for the attack against Nadia Beller.  
Photo Instagram @cerimedofernando

Cerimedo, who partnered with the ultra-right journalist Javier Negre, also a
founder of La Derecha Diario and a friend of the Mexican businessman Ricardo
Salinas Pliego, was a central figure in the campaign that brought Javier Milei
to the Presidency in 2023. According to the Argentine newspaper La Voz, the
consultant publicly admitted that he ran an "army of trolls" to intervene in
social media algorithms and inflate the messages of then-candidate Milei with
Artificial Intelligence (AI).

He was also responsible for organizing the groups of poll watchers for the so-
called Libertarian Party in Argentina and acted as a key intermediary to
arrange Milei's interview with the American journalist Tucker Carlson, which
was widely circulated.

Página 12 states that, on top of this, the consultant apprehended in Bolivia
is a key witness in the Disability case, since he declared that Diego
Spagnuolo, former director of the National Disability Agency and fired by
Milei himself, told him that Karina Milei, the President's sister, demanded
"kickbacks" of three percent on operations with the Agency, together with
Eduardo "Lule" Menem, cousin of former president Carlos Menem.

To the judicial process that Cerimedo now faces in Bolivia is added a process
in Brazil, where the Federal Supreme Court is investigating him for an alleged
attempted coup d'état in 2022. According to La Voz, he is accused of belonging
to a nucleus intended to spread disinformation and attack the Brazilian
electoral system.

And that is not all. In Argentina, in addition to the Disability case, he has
a criminal conviction dating from 2016 for the crimes of fraud and swindling,
as the Mar del Plata court imposed on him a sentence of two years and six
months of suspended prison after selling the same apartment to two different
people.

## How was the attack against Nadia Beller?

The lawyer Nadia Beller was attacked on Monday night in the northern area of
Santa Cruz de la Sierra, where two people who appeared to be delivery workers
intercepted her.

The cameras captured the moment when, with their motorcyclist helmets, they
approached the victim. One of the attackers drew a weapon and fired three
times at Beller, who fell wounded at the scene, and so she was rushed to a
medical center, where she remains hospitalized in guarded condition.

The attack led investigators to pursue several lines of inquiry to identify
those responsible and determine whether there was a link to Javier Milei's
former adviser, who was taken to the facilities of the Special Force to Fight
Crime (FELCC), where he was placed at the disposal of the Bolivian
authorities.

The security camera recordings and other elements gathered during the first
proceedings are also being analyzed to reconstruct the attack, identify those
responsible, and determine what relationship they had with Beller.
